title: Billing Operations Standard: Energy, Service Fee and Sales Tax Lines on Small Business Electricity Supply Bills
content:
## Lines produced each cycle

Each billing cycle in which Beacon Ridge supplied the site under a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement produces one energy charge line, one monthly service fee line when the plan's monthly service fee is above 0.00, and one sales tax line when tax applies. Business supply charges are billed only while the agreement is active, drop pending or closed, as shown by the status on the agreement record.

## Amount of each line

- **Energy charge.** The amount is the kWh billed multiplied by the applicable rate in cents per kWh and divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent. The applicable rate of a fixed plan is the agreement's contract rate for every cycle of the term; the applicable rate of a month-to-month plan follows the business variable rate rules.
- **Monthly service fee.** The amount equals the plan's monthly service fee, and the fee is billed in full for partial cycles.
- **Sales tax.** The taxable amount is the total of the cycle's energy charge and monthly service fee lines; the tax rate is the state sales tax rate for the site's service state; the amount is the taxable amount multiplied by the tax rate and divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent. No sales tax line is billed when that rate is 0.000.

## Sales tax exemption on the bill

No sales tax line is billed for a cycle beginning on or after the tax exemption date when the agreement is marked sales tax exempt. Cycles beginning before the tax exemption date stay taxed and are not refunded, because the plans do not allow Beacon Ridge to refund sales tax billed before an exemption took effect.

## Worked cycle (hypothetical figures)

A New Jersey site on Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 at a contract rate of 9.40 cents per kWh uses 5230 kWh in a cycle.

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Energy charge | 5230 kWh multiplied by 9.40 and divided by 100 | 491.62 USD |
| Monthly service fee | the plan's fee | 9.95 USD |
| Sales tax | 501.57 USD taxable, multiplied by 6.625 and divided by 100, which is 33.2290125, rounded half up | 33.23 USD |

The same cycle at an Ohio site carries no sales tax line, the Ohio rate being 0.000.

## Status and billing

| Agreement status | Supply charges may be billed |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| drop pending | yes |
| closed | yes |
| enrollment pending, rescinded or rejected | no |
